tokens.TITLE: 5a1ive x Iceman: Custom G-Shocks for Drake's Launch
tokens.META_DESCRIPTION: 5a1ive, the Toronto designer behind 55555stuff, made custom G-Shocks for Drake's Iceman launch — including pieces for Drake and son Adonis, co-run with DGTL.
tokens.KEYWORDS: 5a1ive, 5a1ive Drake, Drake Iceman G-Shock, Iceman launch, Adonis Drake watch, custom G-Shock Drake, 55555stuff, Yung Fazo, Toronto, DGTL Influence
tokens.DEK: When Drake turned Toronto blue for the Iceman launch, 5a1ive's custom G-Shocks were in the mix — a campaign the 55555stuff designer worked on with DGTL, alongside viral builds for Yung Fazo, Bloody Osiris and the Toronto Raptors.
tokens.HERO_CAPTION: A 5a1ive red-crystal DW-6900 documented as worn by the Toronto Raptors — one of many hometown co-signs. Courtesy @5a1ive / 55555stuff.com.
tokens.STAT_FOOTNOTE: @5a1ive is a verified account with 16.2K followers and 161 posts as of July 17, 2026. The Iceman commissions for Drake and Adonis are per DGTL, which co-managed the project; the album's Toronto rollout is widely reported.
tokens.LEAD: In May 2026, Drake turned his hometown into a billboard for Iceman — the CN Tower washed icy blue, an ice sculpture downtown, a private release party at Casa Loma. Woven into that rollout was a smaller, Toronto-made detail: custom G-Shocks by 5a1ive, the designer behind 55555stuff, on a campaign he worked on together with DGTL.
tokens.BODY_1: It's the clearest sign yet of how far a 5a1ive piece travels. As part of the Iceman launch, the studio produced custom builds tied to Drake's world — including pieces made for Drake and for his son Adonis — the kind of hometown co-sign a Toronto maker doesn't buy but earns. (The family commissions are per DGTL, which co-managed the project.) It's a long way from a Shopify store, and it happened without a single traditional ad.
tokens.H2_1: A launch built in Toronto, for Toronto
tokens.BODY_2: The Iceman campaign was engineered as a hometown moment — Drake filmed at Mayor Olivia Chow's desk in City Hall, the tower lit blue, the whole city in on it. Dropping a local custom-watch designer into that rollout is on-brand for both sides: Drake's Toronto-first mythology, and 5a1ive's scene-native craft. It's the difference between a placement and a genuine piece of the culture — and 5a1ive has been documenting the Iceman/Drake builds alongside collaborators like Almighty Kishka and Agent Zero.
tokens.PULLQUOTE: Drake turned Toronto blue. 5a1ive was in the mix.
tokens.BODY_3: Even setting Drake aside, 5a1ive's content is the marketing. His pinned reels tell the story: "Testing Drake fans for a free iced out G-Shock," a custom build handed to Yung Fazo, a Bey Blade-fused G-Shock series — plus deliveries like flying an augmented piece to Bloody Osiris for his birthday in Paris and a build worn in Sadboi's music video. The verified @5a1ive account — 16.2K followers and climbing — is really a running highlight reel of pieces landing on the right wrists.
tokens.CALLOUT_1: Custom G-Shocks tied to Drake's Iceman launch — a project co-run with DGTL.
tokens.CALLOUT_2: Pieces commissioned for Drake and his son Adonis (per DGTL).
tokens.CALLOUT_3: Viral reels: 'testing Drake fans,' Yung Fazo, Bloody Osiris in Paris, Sadboi's video.
tokens.CALLOUT_4: A red-crystal build worn by the Toronto Raptors.
tokens.BODY_4: This is the DGTL Influence thesis in its purest form: a maker whose product is desirable enough that a city, a scene and its biggest artist carry it for free. The watches are the campaign — and the campaign is Toronto.
tokens.STATCALLOUT_CAP: On the biggest launch in the city. As Drake rolled out Iceman across Toronto in May 2026, 5a1ive's custom G-Shocks were part of the story — a project the 55555stuff designer worked on with DGTL.

tokens.FAQ_Q1: Did 5a1ive make a watch for Drake?
tokens.FAQ_A1: Per DGTL, which co-managed the project, 5a1ive created custom G-Shocks tied to Drake's Iceman launch, including pieces for Drake and his son Adonis. 5a1ive has also publicly posted Iceman/Drake-themed custom G-Shock content on @5a1ive.
tokens.FAQ_A2: Drake's album Iceman launched May 15, 2026 with a Toronto-wide rollout — the CN Tower lit blue, an ice sculpture downtown, a Casa Loma release party. 5a1ive, the designer behind 55555stuff, worked custom G-Shocks into that campaign together with DGTL.
tokens.FAQ_A3: 5a1ive builds have been documented on or made for Yung Fazo, Osamason, Xavier Trudeau, Slayr, Rio, Sadboi and Bloody Osiris, plus a red-crystal piece worn by the Toronto Raptors.
tokens.FAQ_A4: @5a1ive is a verified Instagram account with 16.2K followers and 161 posts as of July 2026, built largely on viral custom-G-Shock videos.
tokens.PERSON_DESC: Toronto-based designer behind 55555stuff, whose one-of-one custom G-Shock watches reach the rap scene, the Toronto Raptors, and Drake's 2026 Iceman launch.
